experiment: Count the BLAKE3 interior byte copy before entering its loop
status: rejected; production source restored, tests and reproducible experiment archives retained

production_validation.tests: The combined restored-production hash/update/reference/extraction/native-proof suite passed after integration onto 676fe543 (33.547s) and again onto 831644ef (23.392s), including the new input-view cases and wrong-rotate rejection.
production_validation.Lean: All four hash law modules rebuilt successfully after rebase (6 jobs).
production_validation.source: stdlib/hash.oak remains byte-identical to the measured baseline; both archived patches still apply independently.

scope: Complete 1 MiB hashes compiled wholly through C. All three timed libraries are pure C, including compression. No mixed/native runtime comparison and no native emission/proof of either counted prototype.
decision: Neither prototype has a repeatable paired runtime benefit: both improve in A and regress in B and C. Reject both and retain the existing guarded loop. The shared host is too noisy to quantify a precise regression.
hypothesis: Precompute min(64-at,len(src)-i) after the existing first checked byte, then copy that many bytes, avoiding the baseline C compiler's empty induction bookkeeping after memcpy.

baseline.source: Unchanged guarded at<64 && i<len(src) interior loop.

raw-counted.source: Compute room, remaining and count; copy block[at+copied]=src[i+copied] while copied<count; write back at+count and i+count.

guarded-counted.source: Same counted copy, with explicit at+copied<64 && i+copied<len(src) guards in the loop.

variants.shared: Both retain original boundary handling and the first checked byte write; no unsafe copy, alias assumption, public API change or semantic/proof gate relaxation.

static_metrics.measurement: Symbol interval from oak_hash__blake3_uupdate to oak_hash__blake3_ufinal, including trap/stack-check tails; frame from prologue.
static_metrics.inspection: Baseline interior copy lowers to memcpy plus empty induction bookkeeping loops. Both counted forms replace it with larger vector/scalar copy tails; the raw form retains bounds-trap guards, and the explicitly guarded form still needs tail bounds checks.

verification.raw_prototype: Hash/reference/update differential tests passed (27.176s), before the new InputViews test was added. No new InputViews-specific run on this variant.
verification.guarded_prototype: Hash/reference/update differential tests passed (23.980s). Update tests including new InputViews passed in C and interpreter (7.705s).
verification.retained_tests: TestE2EBlake3UpdateInputViews covers nonzero-offset read-only views, source-limited interior counts 0/1/63, unchanged backing prefix/suffix, and a live view overlapping the original state's destination offsets. Full-state comparisons and independently reconstructed original/output bytes prevent common-mode alias corruption from hiding behind the old/new comparison.

verification.proof_limits: Neither rejected counted prototype was formalized. Existing source/extraction/proof pins are unchanged. A fresh baseline-only native compression emission proves all 8 result chunks at default budget, with 0 of 1 verdicts cached; that does not prove either prototype or the C pipeline.

host.limitations: Heavy shared-host load; core placement, frequency and unrelated activity uncontrolled. No builds/tests from this experiment overlap timing.

protocol.timer: CLOCK_MONOTONIC; nanoseconds per complete 1 MiB hash
protocol.order: One thread, rotating interleaved variants within each sample; rotate the library arguments across runs as well.
protocol.warning: Raw before/after/c-control labels are argument positions, not stable identities. All libraries are pure C. The third library is one of the compared variants, not a separate fixed control. Use library_order to interpret raw arrays.
protocol.summary: Ratio of separate medians and median of same-sample candidate/baseline ratios are distinct; retain both and all raw samples. Ratios below 1 favor the prototype.

reproduction: Freeze baseline at 654772017b16f0ece14c7f4e20d762a020e6c98f. Apply each archived patch separately to that baseline, not cumulatively. Production hash source was restored after measurements.
For each variant: go build -o OUT/oak-VARIANT .; OUT/oak-VARIANT build -o OUT/VARIANT-c.c benchmarks/kernels/oak
Pause builds/tests. Run OUT/same-process with absolute library paths in the order shown in each run and arguments 100 21. Capture uptime before/after each run.
Inspect symbols with nm -n and otool -tvV. No native object is linked into any timed library.
